notes.title: Horror Tale 2: Samantha Update – Improved Textures and V-Sync! 👍
notes.content:
We’ve released a small but nice update for Horror Tale 2: Samantha! 😁

What’s new: 
✅ Improved textures and visual effects. 
✅ Added vertical synchronization (V-Sync). 
✅ Fixed minor bugs and issues.

If you haven’t played in a while — it’s the perfect time to replay! Also, we’ve released the continuation of the story — Horror Tale 3: The Witch. It’s already available on Steam! Don’t miss out. 👀
